findings.title: The removal diff's trust gate reads the previous poll's state, and crashes on the first refresh
findings.why_it_matters: app_list_trusted inside _async_update_data reads the previous poll and raises on the first refresh
findings.chosen: Gate the diff on this poll's own health.bootstrap_released with the fresh listing; never call app_list_trusted there

findings.title: A declared entity's child device needs its parent app device registered first, and nothing guarantees that
findings.why_it_matters: HA aborts a child-device entity whose parent isn't registered; platforms set up concurrently
findings.recommended: A: The coordinator registers the app device in its poll pass
findings.chosen: A: The coordinator registers the app device in its poll pass

findings.title: The add rule, availability and D13's removal rule disagree about instances outside hassette's config
findings.why_it_matters: A user's deletion of an out-of-config instance's device is undone by the next poll
findings.recommended: B: Mirror wanted(); available while running, in config or not
findings.chosen: B: Mirror wanted(); available while running, in config or not

findings.title: One poll's absence removes a declared entity (and an instance's device) with no stated reason why that's safe
findings.why_it_matters: Removal relies on HA's deleted-entity restore without saying so
findings.recommended: A: Keep one-poll removal; write down why it's safe
findings.chosen: A: Keep one-poll removal; write down why it's safe

findings.title: The 2026.11 Home Assistant minimum rests on a premise the evidence contradicts
findings.why_it_matters: Child devices date to HA 2026.9; D1 recorded the wrong reason for the floor
findings.recommended: A: Keep 2026.11, correct D1's stated reason
findings.chosen: A: Keep 2026.11, correct D1's stated reason

findings.title: An instance whose entities is None could be read as declaring nothing
findings.why_it_matters: Silent wholesale removal if None is read as []
findings.recommended: A: Skip None instances in the add path and the diff (with a test)
findings.chosen: A: Skip None instances in the add path and the diff (with a test)

findings.title: A sensor value HA still rejects after D4's parsing leaves the sensor stuck with a traceback every poll
findings.why_it_matters: Naive timestamps or unknown classes still fail every poll
findings.recommended: B: Accept as a known limitation
findings.chosen: B: Accept as a known limitation

findings.title: After a toggle, the action refresh usually shows the old switch state for up to 30 s
findings.why_it_matters: Switch snaps back with no explanation until push lands
findings.recommended: A: State the snap-back in the README section
findings.chosen: B: Leave it recorded only in Assumed
findings.choice_reason: 73 will ship at the same time/same release, so we can probably ignore this one
